value.rationale: The natural base alpha=2phi is a nonunit perturbation at the exact boundary of the recent quadratic-unit Beatty-row classification. The theorem resolves the complete pairwise disjointness relation, detects a universal exceptional distance three absent from norm-minus-one sequences, and proves this is the sole deviation. A complete infinite classification rather than an arbitrary numerical slice or routine parameter substitution; it uses special Fibonacci odd-part arithmetic.
